subject: Acme - context length & pricing follow-up
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 25 Feb 2026 16:12:00 -0800
Subject: Acme - call recap & a few follow-ups on tokens / context needs

Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Quick recap and a few follow-ups so we can size pricing accurately: 

Summary of what I heard:
- Primary use case: intelligent summarization + long-document Q&A for customer support knowledge base.
- Volume: ~200k–500k requests/month initially (growth to ~2M reqs/mo in 12 months).
- Latency SLO: 1s p50, 2s p95 for typical short flows; longer for long-document ops.
- Compliance: data stays in VPC (Private deployment discussion pending).

Context & token profiling I need you to confirm (helps pricing):
1) Avg prompt tokens (including system + chat history + doc prefix): ~1,200 tokens (is that right?)
2) Avg completion tokens: ~800 tokens (short answers)
3) Percent of requests that need extended context windows: you mentioned attaching entire KB articles for some flows — estimate? (8k vs 32k vs 128k)
4) Estimated monthly tokens (prompt + completion combined) or target $/1M tokens you want to stay near for budgeting.

Pricing/target economics we discussed on-call: you noted a target of ~$30–$50 per 1M tokens as the ballpark. If you can confirm the profile above, I’ll send a short model/price matrix (8k/32k/128k) plus an example monthly cost calc with a couple of scenarios.

Next steps:
- Alex: confirm avg prompt/completion tokens + % of requests that need >8k context (and % that need 32k/128k).
- I’ll circulate a short pricing matrix and a conservative monthly run-rate calc.

Attachments: acme_usage_sample.json (sample anonymized api call profile)

Thanks,
Marissa
Sr. Account Exec | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0123

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 26 Feb 2026 09:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme - call recap & a few follow-ups on tokens / context needs

Thanks Marissa — quick answers below: 
- Avg prompt tokens: around 1,100–1,300 (1,200 is a good median). Prompts include a short system prompt + 2–3 customer messages + doc prefix when relevant.
- Avg completion tokens: 700–900 (typical is ~800).
- Extended context: about 5% of requests need 32k context (these are deep diff/search ops where we attach multiple KB docs). Almost none require 128k today (maybe <0.1%), but could be useful for future product features.
- Monthly volume: initial pilot ~300M tokens/month (prompt+completion combined). If the pilot goes well, target is 1B tokens/mo within 12 months.
- Budget: rough budget for pilot ~$40k–$60k/month, flexible if unit economics justify it and performance SLOs are met.

Can you send the pricing matrix with both on-demand and committed (reserved) price options? Also curious about disk/embedding costs and any additional fees for private deployment.

Appreciate it — Alex
Alex Chen
Principal PM, Search & Assistants | Acme Corp
alex.chen@acme.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@acme.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Fri, 27 Feb 2026 11:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Acme - call recap & a few follow-ups on tokens / context needs

Appreciate the quick clarifications — helpful. Attached a short pricing matrix and an example calc (see pricing_calc.xlsx and redwood_pricing_sheet.pdf) but summarized below so you can digest quickly. All numbers are USD and per 1M tokens (prompt+completion combined) unless noted.

On-demand (hosted API):
- 8k context model: $45 / 1M tokens
- 32k context model: $95 / 1M tokens
- 128k context model: $240 / 1M tokens

Committed / Reserved (3-12 month commit, typical contract):
- 8k context model: $30 / 1M tokens (with 3mo min commit)
- 32k context model: $65 / 1M tokens
- 128k context model: $160 / 1M tokens

Suggested unit economics for your profile (pilot = 300M tokens/mo):
- If 95% of tokens run on 8k model and 5% on 32k: blended on-demand cost ~ (0.95*$45 + 0.05*$95) = ~$48.25 / 1M -> pilot ≈ $14.5k/month on-demand.
- Blended committed cost (same split) -> (0.95*$30 + 0.05*$65) = ~$31.75 / 1M -> pilot ≈ $9.5k/month committed.

Notes:
- The above simplifies prompt vs completion token splits and assumes identical rates for prompt & completion. We can produce a more granular per-direction price if needed.
- Private (VPC) deployments carry an additional platform fee and hardware pass-through for dedicated GPUs — I attached a separate sheet on typical Private economics.
- For your 1B tokens/mo scale, we can talk deeper discounts and a Reserved capacity plan to keep p95 latency within SLOs and predictable unit cost.

Next steps I propose:
1) Marissa: send official pilot quote (on-demand + committed options) and a simple worksheet with cost scenarios (I attached pricing_calc.xlsx).
2) Alex: confirm if you want a 3-month reserved trial (we can reserve capacity at the committed rates above for the pilot).
3) If yes, I'll loop in Legal for a short MSA + SOW.

Let me know which perf & cost scenario you want me to model (I can send low/medium/high usage).

Best,
Marissa
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: lauren_bishop@redwood.ai, rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 02 Mar 2026 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Internal: ACME pilot pricing recommendation (please advise)

Lauren / Rishi — looping you in with Alex's profile below. Key asks: pilot ~300M tokens/mo, 5% 32k usage, target pilot budget ~$40k–$60k.

My recommendation: offer a 3-month reserved pilot at committed rates with a modest onboarding discount to hit their budget target and lock in roadmap/telemetry access. Proposed commercial:
- 3-month reserved pilot, 300M tokens/mo seat (rolls into committed baseline if they convert)
- Committed blended price: $28 / 1M tokens (blended: 95% 8k, 5% 32k) -> pilot cost = ~$8.4k/mo (this is aggressive)
- Alternatively, conservative reserved blended price: $32 / 1M tokens -> pilot cost = ~$9.6k/mo
- Offer a one-time $15k onboarding credit (applied in month 1) to reach their $40k–$60k expected billing window and accelerate adoption.

Attachments: pricing_calc.xlsx, redwood_pricing_sheet.pdf

Can you confirm legal/commercial okay with 3mo reserved and $15k onboarding credit? If approved, I’ll send a short commercial term sheet to Alex and propose pilot start date mid-March.

Thanks — Marissa
